documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in equipment maintenance. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in equipment maintenance who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a configuration change. They explicitly state this is a support incident and request that support be involved before any expansion discussions. The operational friction is described as 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change and that this is a support incident. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue. Please reach out to them directly for further assistance.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted Cedar Systems support for this issue?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is unknown.
It is unclear whether support has already been contacted.
